_comment: A/L Insight Bot Pterodactyl egg. Import via Admin Panel > Nests > Import Egg, then create a server with it. See deploy/pterodactyl/README.md for full instructions.
name: A/L Insight Bot
description: WhatsApp AI study assistant for Sri Lankan A/L students (Baileys + Gemini). Links a WhatsApp account via pairing code (QR login is disabled) and serves a small status page on SERVER_PORT.

installation.script:
#/bin/bash
# A/L Insight Bot - Pterodactyl installation
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo -e "\033[31mNo package.json found.\033[0m Upload the repository files (or a zip of them) into the server root first, then press Reinstall."
  exit 1
fi

npm install --omit=dev || exit 1
echo -e "Installation complete."

variables.name: WhatsApp phone number (pairing)
variables.description: Your WhatsApp number in international format WITHOUT the + sign, e.g. 94764642432. Required — pairing code is the only login method.

variables.name: Bot name
variables.description: Name shown in the WhatsApp client browser entry.

variables.name: Gemini API key
variables.description: Google AI Studio API key. Optional — only needed for image/vision questions and the official SDK provider.

variables.name: Gemini model
variables.description: Model used by the Gemini SDK (e.g. gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-2.0-flash).

variables.name: AI provider
variables.description: scraper (free gemini.google.com scraping, default) | shyracore (custom API) | gemini (official SDK).

variables.name: Custom AI API URL
variables.description: Used when AI_PROVIDER=shyracore, or as a fallback when the scraper fails.

variables.name: Custom AI API key
variables.description: API key for the custom AI API above.

variables.name: Max conversation history
variables.description: How many past user/assistant turns to keep per user in AI conversations.

variables.name: Session directory
variables.description: Folder where the WhatsApp login session is stored. It persists across restarts; delete it to re-link a new number.
